items.title: RBI rate hike: Your home loan EMI just went up
items.description: The monetary policy committee (MPC) voted unanimously for the increase and adopted a stance of "calibrated tightening". RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said rate cuts were off the table for now, leaving a further increase or a pause as the choices at future meetings. The impact on existing borrowers will depend on the benchmark in their loan agreement. Banks must reset rates on loans linked to an external benchmark at least once every three months.

items.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: Bear markets can breed best investment ideas, says Nilesh Shah
items.description: Nilesh Shah from Kotak Mutual Fund highlights the advantage of bear markets in uncovering robust investment opportunities. He points out that India's growth potential surpasses that of South Korea due to its remarkable talent pool and infrastructure. Shah advises diversifying portfolios with alternative investments like SIFs, credit AIFs, and global funds, suggesting that 15% to 20% be dedicated to international assets.

items.title: F&O Radar: Hedged Call Ratio Spread strategy for Paytm
items.description: Paytm shares display strong bullish momentum following a daily range breakout and accumulation above key EMAs. Choice Broking recommends a Hedged Call Ratio Spread strategy targeting the Rs 1,760-Rs 1,800 zone for the October 27 expiry, offering a max profit of Rs 19,901 with defined risk.

items.title: Jefferies cuts target prices for BSE, Turtlemint & other stocks ahead of Q2 results. Check list
items.description: As the Q2 earnings season approaches, Jefferies has cut target prices for BSE, Turtlemint and several other non-lending financial stocks. The brokerage prefers Groww, Star Health, MCX, ICICI General Insurance, Max Financial, Nuvama and KFin Tech. Here’s a list of the non-lending financial stocks on which Jefferies has slashed its target prices.

items.title: TCS, Infosys, HCL Tech, other IT stocks jump up to 3% despite weak market sentiment. What to expect as Q2 earnings season begins?
items.description: IT stocks rose on Thursday as investors turned their attention to TCS, which is set to kick off the Q2 earnings season. Analysts expect modest sequential revenue growth, while a favourable base and margin support could aid year-on-year growth. Currency tailwinds may also support margins across Indian IT services companies.

items.title: ITC shares slide 3% on block deal buzz; FMCG giant down 29% in 2026
items.description: ITC shares witnessed a drop on Thursday amid reports of likely block deals, with nearly 39 crore shares changing hands across the NSE and BSE. The identities of the buyers and sellers involved in the reported transactions were not immediately known.

items.title: Fino Payments Bank shares surge 13% after September business update; loan referrals jump 223%
items.description: Fino Payments Bank shares surged 13.34% to Rs 145.80 after its September 2026 business update. CASA, deposits, renewal income, digital customers, CMS throughput and loan referrals recorded strong growth, though transaction throughput and new deposit accounts declined. Despite the rally, the stock remains significantly below its 52-week high and trades below four of eight SMAs.

items.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: Will the AI bet pay off? Nilesh Shah weighs in
items.description: At ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0, Kotak Mutual Fund’s Nilesh Shah highlighted the uncertain payoff from massive investments in artificial intelligence. Shah said the global economy has faced repeated disruptions over the past six years, while shifting capital flows, AI and emerging economic powerhouses are reshaping investment opportunities and the next phase of wealth creation.

items.title: Why is market crashing today? Sensex slumps 700 points, Nifty below 22,400. Key factors behind Rs 7 lakh crore wipeout
items.description: Sensex Nifty Down: On Thursday, there was a notable decline in the Indian stock market, marked by a drop of over 1% in both Sensex and Nifty. This downturn was attributed to the RBI's tightening policies and ongoing selling by foreign institutional investors. Sensex plunged over 700 points while Nifty fell by more than 200 points, greatly impacting major companies like ITC and Reliance Industries.

items.title: RBI rate hike done. Now what’s ahead for bank stocks? Jefferies, other analysts weigh in
items.description: RBI’s first rate hike in nearly four years has put the spotlight on banking stocks, with analysts divided on the near-term impact on margins. Jefferies sees large private banks such as ICICI Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank as key beneficiaries, while Q2 earnings could offer clues on the sector’s outlook.

items.title: Paytm, Mobikwik, Pine Labs shares crash up to 10%. What’s behind the sharp plunge?
items.description: Paytm, Mobikwik and Pine Labs shares fall sharply as reports of a possible delay in UPI MDR implementation raise concerns over the fintech companies’ expected benefits from the new fee structure.

items.title: Senco Gold shares gain 6% on strong Q2 business update; revenue rises 31% YoY
items.description: Senco Gold shares rose after the jewellery retailer reported a strong Q2FY27 business update. The company said demand remained robust, driven by festive buying, steady jewelleryconsumption and risingpreference for lightweight jewellery, despite elevated and volatile gold prices.

items.title: Rs 13,000 crore blow in September! Why Indian financial stocks are fastest to sell for FIIs this year
items.description: FIIs sold Rs 13,147 crore worth of financial services stocks in September, accounting for more than a third of their total equity outflow during the month. Banks and financials have remained the biggest target of foreign selling this year, with FIIs offloading Rs 1.15 lakh crore from the sector so far.

items.title: Jubilant FoodWorks shares fall 4% despite Q2 revenue growth of 12% YoY
items.description: Jubilant FoodWorks reported 11.9% YoY growth in consolidated Q2FY27 revenue to Rs 26,087 million, while standalone revenue rose 11.6%. Domino’s India posted 4.1% LFL growth, and the company added 108 stores, taking its network to 3,820. Shares gained 2.42% amid investor focus on demand, sales growth and expansion.

items.title: Vishal Nirmiti shares list at 2% discount over IPO price on NSE, BSE
items.description: On October 8, Vishal Nirmiti made a subdued debut in the stock market, listing below the issue price. This IPO, amounting to Rs 178 crore, included both a fresh issue and an offer for sale. Subscription rates were notably high among retail and non-institutional investors. Proceeds from the IPO are set to support working capital needs and repay loans.

items.title: ITC among 4 F&O stocks with sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of Wednesday, October 7, four stocks in the NSE F&O segment recorded a rise of more than 7% in futures open interest compared with the previous trading session, according to StockEdge F&O scan data. A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a substantial rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security. This may reflect market participants initiating new positions or increasing the size of their existing positions.

items.title: Rainbow Children's Medicare among 3 stocks that closed above VWAP
items.description: On Wednesday, October 7, the closing prices of three stocks in the Nifty 500 universe were above their respective Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP), according to StockEdge's technical scan data.When the closing price is above the VWAP, it means the stock closed at a price higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. The VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: Weekly Top Picks: These stocks scored 10 on 10 on Stock Reports Plus
items.description: Stock Reports Plus, powered by Refinitiv, undertakes detailed company analysis for 4,000+ listed stocks. In addition to detailed company analyses, the report also collates analysts’ forecasts and trend analysis for each component. An average score in Stock Reports Plus is calculated by undertaking quantitative analysis of five key investment tools – earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum.

items.title: M&M, Maruti Suzuki among 6 Sensex stocks that hit 52-week lows and slipped up to 12% in a month
items.description: On Thursday, the benchmark Sensex fell 1,045 points to close at 71,593. Amid the market decline, seven stocks from the BSE Sensex Index touched fresh 52-week lows, hitting their lowest price levels in the past year. A 52-week low refers to the lowest price at which a stock has traded over the past year and is commonly used as an indicator of recent price performance.

items.title: Market wrap: Infosys, Tech Mahindra, Adani Ent, ITC top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Thursday
items.description: Indian markets extended their sell-off as the RBI’s hawkish policy stance pressured rate-sensitive sectors and reset near-term valuations. The Nifty fell 1.64% to 22,231.80, while the Sensex dropped 1.46% to 71,593.24, with metals and realty leading losses.

items.title: India at an inflection point in private credit space: What is creating the opportunity?
items.description: As traditional fixed income evolves, structured credit is emerging as an increasingly relevant allocation. The experts on the Structured Debt panel at ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0 in Mumbai, decode how sophisticated investors assess private debt opportunities, while shedding light on downside protection and yield generation.

items.title: No SIP returns in 2 years? Prashant Jain explains why that's good news for your wealth
items.description: Two years of flat returns have tested SIP investors. Prashant Jain, Founder, 3P Investment Managers, tells ET Digital's Nikhil Agarwal why that is no reason to lose faith. Drawing on his own 11-year wait for returns after 1992, he explains how a flat market helps regular investors build more wealth, and why equities are simple but never easy.

items.title: Citi’s India IB revenue nearly doubles as bank raises $16 billion for clients, shows data
items.description: Citi’s India investment banking revenue nearly doubled to $52 million, making it the country’s top-ranked investment bank. The lender helped Indian companies raise nearly $16 billion and advised on $36 billion of M&A, driven by overseas expansion and technology-sector activity.

items.title: How to Invest in Gold, copper & other commodities? Praveena Rai of MCX Answers
items.description: Praveena Rai of MCX makes the case for adding commodities to investment portfolios, highlighting how AI, infrastructure, manufacturing and electrification are driving demand for metals and energy. At the ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0, Rai explains how commodities can diversify portfolios and outlines ways investors can participate through funds and exchange-traded commodity derivatives.

items.title: Adani Group stocks tumble as market rout deepens; Adani Green, Adani Ent, others tank up to 10%
items.description: On October 8, shares of Adani Group experienced sharp declines amid a wider market downturn, with Adani Green Energy plunging by 10% and Adani Enterprises by 7%. Despite receiving a long-term rating upgrade from CARE Ratings, investor confidence remained shaky. Other subsidiaries, including Adani Power and Adani Ports, also witnessed losses, underscoring the market's inherent volatility and investor unease regarding the current economic climate.

items.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: Equities aren’t enough? Praveena Rai makes a case for commodities
items.description: In India, commodities are steadily gaining traction as a crucial component of investment strategies. As investors diversify beyond conventional assets, they are discovering opportunities in gold, copper, and energy markets. Innovative financial products make it easy to engage in these commodities without the need for physical possession. Success demands a strong grasp of specific commodities and diligence in choosing regulated trading platforms.

items.title: Inside 11-quarter high earnings pomp, 46 companies may wipe out up to 84% of their Q2 profits
items.description: At least 46 companies are expected to report double-digit profit declines in Q2, despite Motilal Oswal projecting 22% earnings growth for its coverage universe. Autos, cement, healthcare, consumer and capital goods are among sectors facing pressure, highlighting the uneven nature of the September-quarter earnings recovery.

items.title: Vedanta dividend alert! Anil Agarwal-led firm announces Rs 5/share interim dividend for FY27. Check record date
items.description: Vedanta dividend 2026: Vedanta has announced its first interim dividend of Rs 5 per share for FY27, with a total payout of Rs 1,955 crore. The dividend comes after the company’s mega demerger earlier this year. Investors will need to hold Vedanta shares by October 14 to qualify, with October 13 being the last buying day.

items.title: 8 smallcap stocks turned multibaggers in 2026 after crashing over 40% in 2025
items.description: Around 79 smallcap stocks have turned multibaggers in 2026, delivering gains of over 100% so far this year. Interestingly, some of these stocks were among the biggest laggards in 2025, highlighting a dramatic turnaround in investor sentiment. In today’s analysis, we highlight eight smallcap stocks that plunged over 40% in 2025 but have more than doubled in 2026, making them some of the year’s biggest turnaround stories. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Nifty 50 hits fresh 52-week low! What technical charts indicate as selloff intensifies
items.description: Nifty 50 plunged below 22,200 to a fresh 52-week low as soaring oil prices, persistent FII selling and the RBI’s rate hike weighed on sentiment. Analysts expect near-term pressure to persist, with market direction likely hinging on Q2 earnings, corporate cash flows and key technical levels in the coming sessions.

items.title: Jefferies sees 76% upside in Kalyan Jewellers in bull case; here is why
items.description: Jefferies has reiterated a Buy rating on Kalyan Jewellers, setting a base target of Rs 830 and a bull-case target of Rs 1,000, implying a 76% upside. The brokerage highlighted market-share gains, store additions, and structural shifts to organised retail as primary long-term growth triggers for the stock.

items.title: F&O Radar: Hedged Call Ratio Spread strategy for Paytm
items.description: Paytm shares display strong bullish momentum following a daily range breakout and accumulation above key EMAs. Choice Broking recommends a Hedged Call Ratio Spread strategy targeting the Rs 1,760-Rs 1,800 zone for the October 27 expiry, offering a max profit of Rs 19,901 with defined risk.

items.title: Mastek shares defy weak markets, gain 3% after Staffordshire County council picks company for Oracle Cloud transformation
items.description: Mastek shares witnessed an uptick on Thursday despite weak market sentiment after its UK subsidiary was selected by Staffordshire County Council for an AI-enabled Oracle Cloud transformation programme. The engagement will cover finance, procurement, human resources and payroll, with Mastek deploying its ADOPT AI platform as the council’s integrated cloud platform.

items.title: These large- and mid-cap stocks can give more than 20% return in 1 year, according to analysts
items.description: The mayhem in the market is likely to continue, at least for the short-term. Nothing has changed in terms of the known headwinds: The US-Iran war continues in fits and starts, oil prices are still elevated, US bond rates remain high, and global supply chains continue to be disrupted. With the calendar year-end approaching, however, there is a technical factor that has entered the mix.

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
items.description: Indian markets plunged on Thursday as RBI policy tightening, persistent FII selling, rising bond yields and rupee weakness battered sentiment. The Nifty hit a 52-week low of 22,179, while the Sensex fell 1,045 points, wiping out over Rs 10 lakh crore.

items.title: Market Trading Guide: Deepa Jewellers among 2 stock recommendations for Friday
items.description: Indian markets remained under pressure as hawkish RBI policy, persistent FII outflows, rising bond yields and rupee weakness weighed on sentiment. Amid the sell-off, analysts identified Brooks Laboratories and Deepa Jewellers as medium-term opportunities based on bullish technical breakouts.

items.title: Rs 9,395 crore block deal! GQG exits ITC shares after a sharp 30% crash this year
items.description: ITC witnessed a nearly Rs 9,437 crore block deal as a GQG-linked fund sold 36.51 crore shares, while Fidelity and major Indian mutual funds bought stakes. The transaction comes as ITC shares remain under pressure from taxation concerns and weak volume recovery.

items.title: Two Trades for Today: A commodities exchange for a 5.95% upmove, a mid-cap financial service stock for a rise of about 6%
items.description: Our technical analysts identify select stocks every trading day that may gain momentum even in volatile markets. Here are the technical calls for today.

items.title: Absence of AI in equities will become India's strength in a year, mkts to start attracting flows: CEA
items.description: Chief Economic Advisor V Anantha Nageswaran indicated that India's absence of AI focus might become an advantage. He believes that if the AI boom falters, foreign investors will seek alternative growth opportunities in India. Despite currency depreciation and external challenges, India maintains strong economic fundamentals and growth. Nageswaran highlighted the manageable current account deficit and well-capitalized banking system as positive factors.
